verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents Insights dashboards where BadgerQL query results can be charted, aggregated, and shared with the team, plus account-wide error views across several projects and cross-project error search. Deploy-scoped queries (`occurred.after:'last deploy'`), deployment correlation with errors, and volume anomaly detection cover parts of the release and volume-over-time angle. However, there is no explicit evidence of error-trend dashboard widgets for top regressions, new issues per release, or per-team breakdowns. missing for 10: documented top-regressions view, new-issues-per-release dashboard, team-level error trend breakdowns, explicit error-volume-over-time charts on dashboards, independent corroboration.
